article.title: Kano senator Suleiman Dandume defects to APC
article.text: Senator Suleiman Kabir Dandume (Kano Demo District 1) on Monday defected from the New Nigeria Peoples Party to the All Progressives Congress. In a statement he signed, the lawmaker said: "I have formally left the NNPP and joined the APC after wide consultations with my constituents." He was received by the state APC chairman in Kano.
